contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), issue of 324-330, Reece period 16, London mint. Pierced at 11.30 o'clock. Obverse description: Diademed bust right. Obverse inscription: [--] TINVS AVG. Reverse description: Campgate with two towers, star above. Reverse inscription: [PROVIDENTIAE] AVGG. In exergue: PLN?V. Diameter: 17.9mm, Weight: 2.21gms, die axis: 12
